in_marathi.name: Taraknath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Taraka
in_marathi.long_meaning: Taraknath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Taraknath is a name derived from Sanskrit, which refers to the Lord of Taraka or the savior from all troubles. Tarakanatha is an epithet of Lord Vishnu and a manifestation of Lord Shiva. In Hindu mythology, Taraknath is believed to protect his devotees from all evils and grant them salvation.

vedic_reference.note: Taraknath is a popular name in Hinduism, derived from the name of Lord Taraka, who is considered the god of deliverance from all kinds of sufferings. In Hindu mythology, Lord Taraka is a form of Lord Vishnu, who is believed to have the power to save his devotees from all forms of distress and misery. The name Taraknath is thus a reverential invocation to this deity, seeking his blessings for protection and deliverance from suffering.
